Former Delhi Chief Minister and Aam Aadmi Party national convener Arvind Kejriwal has received a death threat. The threat states that if Kejriwal does not pay, his family will be targeted—starting with his daughter, who would be killed first. This threat against Kejriwal and his family was issued in the name of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang
